title: A carried quest item keeps its original one-time 'how to use it' flavor text in the inventory listing even after that action is completed — e.g. 'the true pardon, unsent (read over the Hanged Company, forty years late)' still shows that instruction after it was already read aloud at the Gallows Glade.

A carried quest item keeps its original one-time 'how to use it' flavor text in the inventory listing even after that action is completed — e.g. 'the true pardon, unsent (read over the Hanged Company, forty years late)' still shows that instruction after it was already read aloud at the Gallows Glade.
